d: Anthropic fox creature with pale peach fur and white accents, featuring large pointed fox ears, a fluffy white mane, and a long bushy tail. The face is youthful and mature with a gentle expression and amber-brown eyes. The build is slender and curvy, wearing a green strapless bodice with gold trim, matching green arm guards with gold bands, and gold and teal armored leg bands above dark purple stockings. BODY COLOR: Pale peach and white LEGS: Plantigrade with three large toes and a heel.
